anchor_b_clamp_damage._NOTE_on_the_committed_convention: the committed 'free' control deck instantiates NO top-up device on banks 3 and 4 at all, while the clamp deck instantiates one AND fires it.  So the committed +113.565 mV conflates the top-up EXISTING with the top-up FIRING.  chain3 measured that merely having the gate present shifts t_zcs by +11.5 ps and VBEND2 by -43.4 mV, so the conflation is not negligible.  Every free control in qal/tankfed carries the top-up devices PHYSICALLY PRESENT and parked off, which isolates the firing term.  This anchor is reproduced on the committed convention so the instrument is anchored; the run's own numbers use the stricter one.
